title: Fire-Boltt Rise Smart Watch 1.85" HD Display with Bluetooth Calling, AI Voice Assistant, Rotating Crown, SpO2 & Heart Rate Monitor, 120+ Sports Modes, Smart Watch for Men & Women - Cinnamon Slate
bullets: 【1.85-inch HD Touchscreen Display for Immersive Clarity】 – Experience seamless navigation and stunning visuals with a large 1.85-inch HD touchscreen display. Whether you're checking notifications, tracking workouts, or making calls, the crystal-clear screen ensures effortless accessibility and vibrant colors for an unmatched user experience.

【Cinnamon Slate & Ice Grey – Smartwatch Colors of the Year】 – The all-new Cinnamon Slate and Ice Grey editions are making headlines as the smartwatch colors of the year. Cinnamon Slate brings a bold, sophisticated look, while Ice Grey exudes elegance and versatility—making them must-have colors for 2025!

【Premium Metal Body for a Sleek & Durable Design】 – Crafted with a sleek metal body, this Fire-Boltt smartwatch boasts a modern, stylish, and durable design. Whether you're at the gym, office, or casual outings, its premium finish enhances your look while ensuring long-lasting durability.

【Smart Rotating Crown for Effortless Navigation】 – Enjoy intuitive control and seamless navigation with the smart rotating crown. Easily scroll through menus, apps, notifications, and settings with a simple turn, adding a luxurious and convenient touch to your smartwatch experience.

【120+ Sports Modes for Ultimate Fitness Tracking】 – Elevate your workouts with over 120 sports modes, including running, cycling, swimming, yoga, hiking, strength training, and more. This advanced fitness smartwatch offers real-time tracking, calorie monitoring, and performance analytics to help you crush your fitness goals.

【Bluetooth Calling Smartwatch – Stay Connected on the Go】 – Never miss an important call with built-in Bluetooth calling. Make and receive calls directly from your wrist, ensuring instant connectivity without having to pull out your phone—perfect for busy professionals, fitness lovers, and multitaskers.

【Comprehensive Health Monitoring for 24/7 Wellness】 – Keep track of your health with advanced heart rate tracking, SpO2 (Blood Oxygen) monitoring, and detailed sleep analysis. This feature-packed smartwatch ensures you have a comprehensive health overview at all times, keeping your well-being in check.

【Smart Notifications & Quick Access Alerts】 – Stay updated with instant call, message, and social media notifications right on your wrist. Whether it's WhatsApp, Instagram, SMS, or emails, this Fire-Boltt Bluetooth calling smartwatch keeps you informed without reaching for your phone.
